282:t_1:3.en: ～$$木星$$ Sector　$$ソレスタルビーイング$$ Base～

282:t_1:4.en:
$$リンダ$$
「...Welcome back, everyone. Miss $$スメラギ$$'s report gave me a general idea of what happened.」

282:t_1:5.en:
$$イアン$$
「Thanks for the welcome, $$リンダ$$.」

282:t_1:6.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「It's been so long, Mom!」

282:t_1:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So $$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s base is in satellite orbit around $$木星$$.」

282:t_1:8.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「We need a high-gravity environment to manufacture GN Drives.」

282:t_1:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Helium-3 collection fleets visit $$木星$$ too, so several facilities support them here alongside our base.」

282:t_1:10.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「It's a small population, but people live out here too.」

282:t_1:11.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Still, we're lucky we can replenish our food and other supplies here.」

282:t_1:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...I understand how you feel, $$シン$$. Given what $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ did in the past, relying on us is...」

282:t_1:14.en:
$$シン$$
「That isn't it...! It's $$イアン$$ I can't accept!」

282:t_1:16.en:
$$シン$$
「How can $$イアン$$ and $$リンダ$$ be married!? I can't accept a 25-year age gap!」

282:t_1:18.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「You're far too surprised, $$リンクス$$.」

282:t_1:19.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I can't believe this is allowed...」

282:t_1:20.en:
$$シン$$
「Right, $$バナージ$$...! You think so too, don't you!?」

282:t_1:21.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「What are you two talking about...?」

282:t_1:23.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You got angry about the same thing before, $$シン$$.」

282:t_1:25.en:
$$キラ$$
「You really do hold a grudge, $$シン$$.」

282:t_1:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Being strong-willed can be a pain sometimes.」

282:t_1:27.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「I agree with $$カミーユ$$. ...Come on, $$シン$$. Stop being so rude.」

282:t_1:29.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Hehe... Now that we've made it back to the solar system, everyone seems a little more relaxed.」

282:t_1:30.en:
$$刹那$$
「It's understandable. We've faced one crisis after another since the $$時空震動$$ in $$第２新東京市$$.」

282:t_1:31.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Still, though we came here by chance, the timing is perfect.」

282:t_1:32.en:
$$リンダ$$
「Thanks to the $$イノベイド$$s' help, we're in the final stages of tuning that project.」

282:t_1:33.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「You're using their ability to receive $$脳量子波$$?」

282:t_1:34.en:
$$イアン$$
「Right... Let's get straight to finishing it up.」

282:t_1:35.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What are you talking about?」

282:t_1:36.en:
$$刹那$$
「To explain that, $$バナージ$$... I'd like to borrow your power, and the $$ユニコーン$$'s.」

282:t_1:38.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Yes. That machine was designed around the same concept. Its operating data should be useful too.」

282:t_1:39.en:
$$刹那$$
「Is that all right, $$バナージ$$?」

282:t_1:40.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If I can be of any help, I'd be happy to.」

282:t_1:41.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「...While $$刹那$$ and $$ティエリア$$ are working, I think I'll take some personal time.」

282:t_1:43.en:
$$クェス$$
「Hey, what's going on? What does he mean, personal time?」

282:t_1:45.en:
$$マリー$$
「Hehe... Judging by your reactions, you two sensed $$ロックオン$$'s feelings too.」

282:t_1:46.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「It's just what you're thinking. Someone very dear to $$ロックオン$$ works here on the staff.」

282:t_1:50.en: ～Inside the $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ Base～

282:t_1:51.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm thrilled this base on $$木星$$ has a big bath! I finally got to bathe without worrying about water.」

282:t_1:52.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I know it saves water and energy, but I never expected all the female members to bathe at once...」

282:t_1:53.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But it's a little strange. Only Earth and the Moon come in pairs. All the other planets have just one version.」

282:t_1:54.en:
$$ラルク$$
「They say the other planets merged between the $$蒼の地球$$'s solar system and the $$翠の地球$$'s.」

282:t_1:55.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Hmm... So the parallel worlds only remain separate around Earth.」

282:t_1:58.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノリコ$$... The biggest difference between you and $$ノノリリ$$ was that she had an amazing figure, but...」

282:t_1:61.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But my Big Sis and $$ユング#pilot$$ were even prettier and had bigger breasts.」

282:t_1:63.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Your soft, pale skin turned pink in the steam, $$ノリコ$$. Oh, it was just irresistible!」

282:t_1:64.en:
$$チコ$$
「That's enough. The guys don't know how to react.」

282:t_1:68.en:
$$シェリル$$
「What do you mean, heard it...? You're the ones who started talking about it.」

282:t_1:70.en:
$$アルト$$
「I-I didn't hear anything! Really, I didn't hear anything about pink skin!」

282:t_1:71.en:
$n
「$$アルト$$... If I'm the quiet type, you're a closet pervert.」

282:t_1:72.en:
$n
「And if you stop being the quiet type like I did, you'll just be a pervert...!」

282:t_1:73.en:
$$アルト$$
「What the hell are you talking about!?」

282:t_1:74.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't use this as your chance to get even, $n.」

282:t_1:75.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...Were you listening too, $$レド$$?」

282:t_1:76.en:
$$レド$$
「Of course. Gathering intelligence is fundamental to tactics.」

282:t_1:77.en:
$n
「$$レド$$... So you've already stopped being the quiet type.」

282:t_1:79.en:
$$レド$$
「...I don't understand. Is a report on the opposite sex's bathing conditions so unusual?」

282:t_1:81.en:
$$レド$$
「In the $$人類銀河同盟$$, men and women bathe together.」

282:t_1:84.en:
$$ボス$$
「I-I... For the first time, I'm jealous of $$レド$$...」

282:t_1:85.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Supplementary explanation. The $$人類銀河同盟$$ recognizes differences between the sexes only in specific situations.」
